en:
<CLT=cltMIND>We decided to hang out
in the library.

<CLT=cltMIND>It looks like we're the only ones here...
What should we do?

I haven't read any manga in years...
For some reason, it makes me tense.

Well...thanks to you, I've been feeling
pretty nostalgic lately...

Before being trapped here,
boredom was a luxury for me.

I was constantly busy,
so I valued any free time I had.
So now, I think boredom is good.
...I guess I did change a little bit.

<CLT=cltMIND>I wonder what's wrong?
Maki looks deep in thought...
